tickets.name: Skyhook
tickets.note: Let's take a road trip. First stop Wembanyama, then Kuzma, Reid and Okongwu. Up it goes at center court, and Wembanyama snatches the first possession for the Spurs. Kilowatt Kuzma! Kuzma takes the opening swing for the Bucks more nights than not. Rim-Rattlin' Reid! The Hornets swing it twice and it ends up where it always seems to end up: Reid. It's Okongwu at center court, all elbows and knees and ambition. He's got a knack for the tip that you just can't teach. Cross your fingers, cross your toes, cross the street if you have to!

tickets.name: Lob City
tickets.note: Wembanyama brings the band; Kuzma, Watson and Thompson bring the noise. Wembanyama tips it, the Spurs push it, and he's rolling to the basket for the first look. Kuzma comes off the pin-down, catches, rises, and the Bucks bench is already standing. Hotter than Granny's woodstove! Watson is the dark horse in the Cavaliers barn, and that horse can run. First possession, Thompson on the left wing, and he's not here to pass. Nobody blink!

tickets.name: Transition
tickets.note: Roll call! Embiid, Reid, Okongwu and Watson, everybody present and accounted for. They call him Electric Embiid, and I just did too. Opening toss, Embiid skies for it, and the 76ers start on offense. The ball's in Reid's hands before the crowd has found its seats. Quicker on the trigger than a spring-loaded mousetrap! Overdrive Okongwu, y'all. Win the tip, then dive to the rim: that's how Okongwu likes to start the evening. Wrecking-Ball Watson! Don't look now, but Watson is lurking for the Cavaliers. The porch light's on, come on home, ticket.

tickets.name: Run and Gun
tickets.note: Grab a plate. Embiid, Reid, Washington and Daniels are on the menu tonight. Embiid goes up like he's reaching for the top shelf at the grocery store. Reid gets a step on the opening play and takes it all the way. Hotter than the asphalt at a summer cookout! Here's Wildfire Washington. Before the sweat even starts, Washington has the ball and a look in his eye. Daniels sets up shop on the weak side and waits for somebody to forget him. Ticket's in, nerves are on.

tickets.name: Heat Check
tickets.note: Four first baskets on one slip, with Adebayo riding up front. Adebayo up top on the tip, and the Heat run their very first set right back through him. His tip record reads like a winning streak at the county fair. Kuzma catches it off the curl, and you can see the shot leaving before it does. With the guts of a cat burglar! Up goes the ball, up goes Okongwu, and the Hawks come out running. Watson drifts to the dunker spot and waits for the gift. Sneakier than a kid in the cookie jar! Bold as brass, and twice as shiny.

tickets.name: Buzzer Beater
tickets.note: We're spinning the wheel with Adebayo, Kuzma, Washington and Daniels, so hang on. Adebayo reaches for the rafters on the opening toss and taps it home to the Heat. He has been owning that circle all season long. Kuzma catches it on the wing in the opening minute, and that trigger finger is already itchy. Hotter than a skillet in July! Washington is first off the screen and first to fire. Holy guacamole! Daniels at a long price, and long prices are where the fun lives. Shimmy, shake and bake! Strap in. Bumpy ride, beautiful view.

tickets.name: Showtime
tickets.note: Allen, Kuzma, Reid, Okongwu. Say it fast and it sounds like a fight song. All-Day Allen, y'all. Allen gets the tip, the Cavaliers get the ball, and the big fella gets position. Kuzma gets a clean look on the first trip and takes it before anybody can blink. Hotter than a fresh-fried hush puppy! Reid gets it in the corner, one dribble, two feet, let it go. Okongwu at the opening jump, and he's got springs in those sneakers tonight. Let the good times roll!

tickets.name: Alley-Oop
tickets.note: Four tips go up tonight, and we've got Allen, Kuzma, Washington and Thompson waiting underneath. Allen gets a paw on the tip, rolls to the rim, and the Cavaliers feed the big fella. The Bucks call his number on the very first set, and Kuzma doesn't need to be asked twice. Hotter than a pepper-eating contest! The Mavericks set a screen for Washington before anybody's broken a sweat, and up it goes. Smoother than grandma's gravy! Here's Turbo Thompson. Thompson with the hesitation dribble on the opening possession, and the defender's still looking for his shoe. Get the band warmed up!

tickets.name: Garrett's Temple
tickets.note: Garrett built this one brick by brick: Wembanyama, Embiid, Adebayo and Allen. Toss, tap, sprint, seal. That's the Wembanyama special. Tip after tip after tip, the man just keeps winning them. Embiid tips it forward, and he's the first one to the rim on the other end too. Adebayo wins the jump, trails the play, and the Heat find him all alone. Win the tip, take the first swing, and nobody wins the tip like him. Center jump, Allen against the world, and the world is losing. He treats the opening jump like a family heirloom: he does not let it go. Ring the bells in the Temple tonight!
